metadata.title: Example Tactical UAS Ground Control Station Plan of Action and Milestones (draft)

observations.title: ac-2 determination
observations.description: Directory change tickets and the 2026-09-08 review show CAC accounts approved and reviewed, but the shared gcsmaint and GDT vendor administrator accounts are not individually assigned.

observations.title: ac-2.4 determination
observations.description: Workstation and router account events reached the collector in DT-1; GDT administrator account events stay in a local log that is not forwarded.

observations.title: ac-2.7 determination
observations.description: Admin group membership is ISSO-approved and reviewed, but the privileged gcsmaint and GDT vendor administrator accounts are shared and not tied to individual users.

observations.title: ac-2.9 determination
observations.description: Shared-account use is limited and the password rotates, but use cannot be attributed to a person, as the 2026-09-08 review recorded.

observations.title: ac-2.12 determination
observations.description: No one monitors account use while a station is disconnected; the ISSO weekly report is used only during test events.

observations.title: ac-6.9 determination
observations.description: Workstation privilege use and router sessions are logged and forwarded, but GDT administrator actions are not forwarded and gcsmaint actions cannot be tied to a person.

observations.title: au-6 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the ISSO weekly review ran on all six test stations for four weeks (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-26), with GDT and planner logs reviewed by hand, and the enclave daily review of forwarded records found no anomalies. Still open: GDT and planner logs are not forwarded and no forwarding date is set, and weekly review on fielded stations is not yet shown. A-3 result: other-than-satisfied (FND-007).

observations.title: au-6.3 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: workstation and router records are still correlated in the enclave; GDT and planner records are still not collected or correlated (hand review only). Unchanged from A-3 (FND-008).

observations.title: au-10 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the 2026-10-14 screen-lock change on etgcs-p3-ws was made in a gcsmaint session and could not be tied to a person; the shared account is unchanged until release 2.4 (2027-02). Unchanged from A-3 (FND-009).

observations.title: ca-3 determination
observations.description: IC-2 enclave connection approval is signed; the IC-1 agreement with the brigade intelligence system is an unsigned draft.

observations.title: ca-5 determination
observations.description: No POA&M exists yet for the station; it is to be opened from this report.

observations.title: ca-6 determination
observations.description: The AO is assigned but the station has no authorization decision yet.

observations.title: ca-7 determination
observations.description: The compliance check and enclave daily review run and the system strategy is written, but its monitoring activities have not started and planner and GDT logs are not monitored.

observations.title: ca-7.1 determination
observations.description: Independent ongoing assessment is defined in the strategy but has not run.

observations.title: ca-7.3 determination
observations.description: No trend analysis of monitoring results has run.

observations.title: ca-7.4 determination
observations.description: Only configuration compliance is monitored; effectiveness and change monitoring have not started.

observations.title: ca-7.5 determination
observations.description: Consistency actions are defined in the strategy but have not run.

observations.title: ca-7.6 determination
observations.description: No automated monitoring dashboard exists yet.

observations.title: cm-5.1 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: change access is enforced and the check caught the 2026-10-14 screen-lock change, but it was made under the shared gcsmaint account and could not be tied to a person. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-019).

observations.title: cm-5.5 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the quarterly account review confirmed gcsmaint is still shared by five maintainers on each workstation and router; GDT vendor administrator passwords are unique per station but still one shared account per GDT. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-020).

observations.title: cm-6 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the witnessed 2026-10-24 STIG scan shows the workstation and router baselines in place with no new open findings; the planner's hand-applied settings were not re-verified and the flight control and video applications are still unchecked against the SRG (STG-003..005 not reviewed). Unchanged from A-3 (FND-021).

observations.title: cm-9 determination
observations.description: ART-CMP in the package is a summary; the full configuration management plan is drafted but not signed.

observations.title: cp-2 determination
observations.description: The plan summary states the strategy, 4-hour restore and critical assets; the full plan with roles, contacts and recovery procedures does not exist.

observations.title: cp-3 determination
observations.description: No operator, maintainer or ISSO has been trained on the station swap and restore.

observations.title: cp-4 determination
observations.description: The contingency plan has never been tested or exercised; the first tabletop is scheduled for the week of 2026-11-16, after the assessment window.

observations.title: cp-4.1 determination
observations.description: No plan test has been coordinated with the brigade continuity or enclave incident response exercises.

observations.title: ia-2 determination
observations.description: DT-1 and the 2026-09-08 review confirm CAC sign-in for directory users, but 5 maintainers share gcsmaint on each workstation and router and the GDT has one vendor administrator account.

observations.title: ia-2.1 determination
observations.description: Remote administrators use CAC and PIN, but privileged maintenance through gcsmaint and the GDT administrator account is password only.

observations.title: ia-2.5 determination
observations.description: Break-glass envelopes are sealed and unused, but maintainers use gcsmaint with no prior individual authentication.

observations.title: ia-2.6 determination
observations.description: The CAC is a separate device for directory users; gcsmaint and GDT administrator access uses no separate device.

observations.title: ia-4 determination
observations.description: Directory identifiers have supervisor-signed requests on file, but the gcsmaint and GDT vendor administrator identifiers are not assigned to individuals.

observations.title: ia-5 determination
observations.description: CAC lifecycle via DoD PKI and a 60-day gcsmaint change (last 2026-09-30), but gcsmaint is shared and the GDT administrator password has never changed since installation.

observations.title: ia-5.1 determination
observations.description: Passwords are stored hashed, but the shared gcsmaint password and the unchanged GDT administrator password do not meet password-based authentication requirements.

observations.title: ia-5.6 determination
observations.description: CAC keys stay on the card, but the gcsmaint password is known to all 5 maintainers.

observations.title: ia-5.8 determination
observations.description: The same shared gcsmaint account and password exist on every workstation and router.

observations.title: ir-2 determination
observations.description: No operator, maintainer or ISSO has received station incident response training.

observations.title: ir-2.3 determination
observations.description: No breach-handling training has been given.

observations.title: ir-3 determination
observations.description: The incident response capability has never been tested; the tabletop is scheduled for the week of 2026-11-16, after the assessment window.

observations.title: ir-3.2 determination
observations.description: No test has been coordinated with the brigade or the enclave CSSP.

observations.title: ir-4 determination
observations.description: CSSP handling is in place (test ticket 2026-10-20) and isolation and reimage were walked through on station 5, but the station handling procedure behind them is only a summary.

observations.title: ir-4.1 determination
observations.description: Workstation and router events reach the collector, but DT-1 confirmed planner and GDT logs are not forwarded, so their handling is manual.

observations.title: ir-4.4 determination
observations.description: The CSSP correlates workstation and router events; planner and GDT events are not forwarded and cannot be correlated.

observations.title: ir-4.6 determination
observations.description: Audit records cannot tie gcsmaint actions to a person, which defeats insider threat handling for maintenance actions.

observations.title: ir-8 determination
observations.description: ART-IRP is a summary only; no full plan with procedures, metrics and approval exists.

observations.title: ir-8.1 determination
observations.description: The plan has no breach-handling section.

observations.title: ir-9.2 determination
observations.description: No spillage response training has been given.

observations.title: ma-2 determination
observations.description: Station maintenance logs record every action since 2026-07 with date and task, but the sign-in shows gcsmaint and the maintainer is named only for scheduled work.

observations.title: ma-3.5 determination
observations.description: Privileged maintenance sessions are logged, but under gcsmaint the use of privileged tools cannot be tied to a person.

observations.title: pl-8.2 determination
observations.description: The layers are separate devices under separate administration, but no layer's supplier is recorded, so supplier diversity is not shown.

observations.title: pl-9 determination
observations.description: Accounts come from the brigade directory and every station runs the one signed bundle, but only workstation and router logs reach the enclave collector; planner and GDT logs are not centrally managed.

observations.title: pm-5.1 determination
observations.description: The Component PII inventory exists, but the station is not entered in it because its privacy threshold analysis is not approved.

observations.title: pt-2 determination
observations.description: The authority is named in the draft privacy threshold analysis, but the analysis is not approved, so the authority to process is not yet determined and documented.

observations.title: pt-3 determination
observations.description: The two purposes are written in the draft privacy threshold analysis, which is not approved.

observations.title: ra-5 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the 2026-10-24 scan after the 2026-10 bundle confirms the three medium workstation and router findings fixed and no new high or critical findings; the GDT management web service vulnerability is still open on all six stations (firmware 5.1.8, 5.2.1 in regression testing for the 2026-12 bundle, service reachable only from the station internal network), the two planner library findings are open with no vendor fix date, and the planner is still outside any compliance scan. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-054).

observations.title: ra-7 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: every open finding is now tracked as an item with milestones in the POA&M opened at A-6 (ART-POAM), reviewed monthly by the ISSO and ISSM. A-3 result: other-than-satisfied (FND-055, now closed).

observations.title: ra-8 determination
observations.description: The privacy threshold analysis is drafted but unsigned by the SAOP designee, so the privacy impact assessment decision has not been made.

observations.title: ra-10 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the CSSP hunt still sees only workstation and router records in the enclave collector; GDT and planner records still do not arrive. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-057).

observations.title: sa-3.3 determination
observations.description: Mission planner vendor support ends 2027-06; no replacement is selected and the market survey has not started.

observations.title: sa-5 determination
observations.description: Administrator and user guides and the STIG summary exist for the workstation and router, but the mission planner has no security guide and its hand-hardening list is untested.

observations.title: sa-8.22 determination
observations.description: CAC users are accountable, but gcsmaint actions on the workstation and router cannot be tied to a person; the fix is planned for release 2.4 (2027-02).

observations.title: sa-11 determination
observations.description: Developer testing and DT-1 cover the listed functions, but the mission planner's hardening was never tested and this assessment did not test it either (STG-003 not reviewed).

observations.title: sc-5 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: default deny, uplink rate limit and deny logging held with no router drift in the cycle's compliance checks, but the 2026-10-24 scan shows the GDT management web service crash vulnerability still open on all six stations (firmware 5.1.8; 5.2.1 in regression testing for the 2026-12 bundle); the service is still reachable only from the station internal network. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-062).

observations.title: si-2 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the 2026-10 bundle is on all six stations and the 2026-10-24 rescan confirms the three medium workstation and router fixes with no new high or critical findings, but the GDT management web service vulnerability (vendor high, firmware 5.1.8) and the two medium planner library findings remain unremediated. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-063).

observations.title: si-4 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: workstation and router events reached the enclave collector after every reconnect and the ISSO weekly review ran in all four weeks with GDT and planner logs reviewed by hand, but GDT and planner logs are still not forwarded or monitored by the enclave, and the evidence covers only the six test-range stations. Improved but unchanged in result (FND-064).

observations.title: si-4.14 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the GDT local log was looked at by hand in the weekly reviews on the test-range stations, but it is still not forwarded, alerted on or reviewed on fielded stations, so radio-link intrusion attempts are not reliably seen. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-065).

observations.title: si-4.16 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: planner and GDT events still do not reach the enclave collector, so they are not correlated with other monitoring. Unchanged from A-3 (FND-066).

observations.title: si-4.19 determination
observations.description: M-2 2026-10-29: the weekly review of maintainer and administrator activity now ran in every week of the cycle, but gcsmaint is still shared by five maintainers and the 2026-10-14 screen-lock change on etgcs-p3-ws could not be tied to a person. Unchanged in result (FND-067).

observations.title: si-10 determination
observations.description: Developer tests show flight control and video validation works; the mission planner's input validation is the vendor's and has never been independently tested.

observations.title: sr-3 determination
observations.description: Approved-supplier acquisition and signed deliveries are in place, but the mission planner reaches vendor end of support in 2027-06 with no replacement selected and no selection date.

risks.title: Unattributable misuse of shared privileged accounts
risks.description: Threat TE-5 (insider misuse or error, or an outsider with a disclosed credential); weakness: one shared gcsmaint credential on every workstation and router and a never-changed GDT administrator password; effect: privileged changes to any station without an attributable record.
risks.statement: Likelihood moderate and impact high give a moderate risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Attacks go unnoticed in local-only and unreviewed logs
risks.description: Threat TE-8 (adversary activity while disconnected); weakness: planner and GDT logs stay on the devices, station logs are not reviewed while disconnected, events are not correlated; effect: intrusion or misuse undetected for days.
risks.statement: Likelihood moderate and impact moderate give a moderate risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Exploitation of known GDT and mission planner vulnerabilities
risks.description: Threats TE-6 and TE-7 (adversary on the station segment or via removable media); weakness: GDT management web service crash flaw pending firmware 5.2.1 and planner library flaws without a vendor fix; effect: loss of the GDT management service or compromise of the planner.
risks.statement: Likelihood moderate and impact moderate give a moderate risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Unassessed mission planner hardening and configuration
risks.description: Threat TE-7 (exploitation of a misconfigured planner); weakness: planner, flight control and video application settings unverified, planner hardening, documentation and input validation untested, STIG items STG-003 to STG-005 not reviewed; effect: an unknown configuration weakness is exploited.
risks.statement: Likelihood low and impact moderate give a low risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Incidents and outages handled without written, tested plans
risks.description: Threats TE-1, TE-3 and TE-6 realized; weakness: contingency, incident response and configuration management plans are drafts, never tested, and no one is trained; effect: slow or wrong response that extends mission loss.
risks.statement: Likelihood moderate and impact moderate give a moderate risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Mission planner end of support without a replacement
risks.description: Threats TE-4 and TE-7; weakness: vendor support ends 2027-06 with no replacement selected; effect: flaws found after that date stay unfixed.
risks.statement: Likelihood low and impact high give a low risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Continuous monitoring and governance not yet operating
risks.description: Threat TE-8 over time; weakness: ongoing assessment, trend, effectiveness and consistency analysis and the dashboard have not started, the POA&M and authorization did not exist at assessment, supplier diversity is undocumented; effect: control drift is not detected.
risks.statement: Likelihood low and impact low give a low risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: Interconnection operated without a signed agreement
risks.description: Weakness: the IC-1 interconnection agreement is out for signature; effect: security responsibilities at the enclave connection are not binding.
risks.statement: Likelihood low and impact low give a low risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

risks.title: PII processed before privacy approvals
risks.description: Threat TE-2 (exposure of operator identifiers); weakness: privacy threshold analysis, authority and purposes not approved and the station is not in the PII inventory; effect: PII processing without documented authority.
risks.statement: Likelihood low and impact low give a low risk level (SP 800-30); response: mitigate.

findings.title: Shared maintenance and GDT administrator accounts are not individually assigned
findings.description: ac-2 requires accounts assigned to individuals. The shared gcsmaint account on each workstation and router is used by 5 maintainers, and the GDT has one vendor administrator account; the 2026-09-08 review recorded the gap.
findings.remarks: Replace gcsmaint and the GDT vendor account with per-maintainer accounts and offline CAC sign-in (release 2.4); until then keep a signed maintenance log naming the user of each session.

findings.title: GDT administrator account events are not forwarded for audit
findings.description: ac-2.4 requires account actions audited and notified. The GDT keeps administrator account events only in a local log that is not forwarded to the enclave collector.
findings.remarks: Forward GDT logs to the collector, or until then have the ISSO export and review the GDT log at each reconnect.

findings.title: Privileged roles include shared accounts not tied to individual users
findings.description: ac-2.7 requires privileged accounts managed per role and user. gcsmaint and the GDT vendor administrator account are privileged and shared.
findings.remarks: Per-maintainer privileged accounts in release 2.4; record who holds the GDT administrator credential.

findings.title: Use of shared accounts cannot be attributed to a person
findings.description: ac-2.9 allows shared accounts only under defined conditions. Logs show gcsmaint but not who used it, and the paper log covers scheduled work only.
findings.remarks: Retire the shared accounts in release 2.4; meanwhile log every gcsmaint and GDT administrator session with the maintainer's name.

findings.title: Account use is not monitored while stations are disconnected
findings.description: ac-2.12 requires monitoring for atypical account use. S6 reviews logs only after reconnect, and the ISSO weekly station report is not in operational use.
findings.remarks: Put the ISSO weekly station report into operational use and review station logs locally during disconnected periods.

findings.title: Privileged functions on the GDT and under gcsmaint are not attributably logged
findings.description: ac-6.9 requires logging the use of privileged functions. GDT administrator actions stay in the GDT's local log, and gcsmaint actions are logged without the person.
findings.remarks: Forward GDT logs and replace gcsmaint with per-maintainer accounts (release 2.4).

findings.title: Station logs are not reviewed while disconnected, and GDT and planner logs are never reviewed
findings.description: au-6 requires audit records reviewed and analyzed at a defined frequency. The ISSO weekly station review runs only during test events, and GDT and mission planner logs are not forwarded, so no one reviews them.
findings.remarks: Run the ISSO weekly review on every station from first fielding, set a date for GDT and planner log forwarding, and until then export and review those logs at each reconnect. M-2 2026-10-29: the interim weekly hand review ran in the cycle on all test stations; the forwarding date is still missing.

findings.title: GDT and mission planner records are not correlated with other records
findings.description: au-6.3 requires records analyzed and correlated across repositories. GDT and planner records stay local and never reach the enclave collector.
findings.remarks: Forward GDT and planner logs to the enclave collector; set a target date in the POA&M.

findings.title: Actions under the shared gcsmaint account are not attributable
findings.description: au-10 requires irrefutable evidence of who performed an action. Records of gcsmaint actions show only the shared account name.
findings.remarks: Per-maintainer accounts with offline CAC sign-in in release 2.4; meanwhile a signed maintenance log for every gcsmaint session.

findings.title: IC-1 interconnection agreement with the brigade intelligence system is not signed
findings.description: ca-3 requires each external connection to be approved and documented in an agreement stating interface characteristics, security requirements and responsibilities. IC-2 is approved; the IC-1 agreement is an unsigned draft, so those terms are not agreed with the receiving system's owner.
findings.remarks: Get the IC-1 agreement signed by both owners before fielding and set an annual review for both agreements.

findings.title: No POA&M exists for the station
findings.description: ca-5 requires a plan of action and milestones for the weaknesses found. None exists at assessment time.
findings.remarks: Open the POA&M from this report's findings and the disclosed limitations, and update it monthly.

findings.title: The station is not yet authorized to operate
findings.description: ca-6 requires the AO to authorize the system before operation. The AO is assigned, but no decision has been made.
findings.remarks: Complete the package and obtain the AO's decision, including acceptance of the inherited common controls, before fielding.

findings.title: System-level continuous monitoring is not operating and planner and GDT logs are not monitored
findings.description: ca-7 requires continuous monitoring per the system strategy. Only the start-up compliance check and the enclave's daily review of forwarded workstation and router records run; the strategy's metrics, frequencies and reporting have not started, and planner and GDT logs are not forwarded, so nothing monitors them.
findings.remarks: Start the strategy's first monitoring cycle at authorization and include planner and GDT logs once forwarding is in place (see FND-007).

findings.title: Independent ongoing assessment has not started
findings.description: ca-7.1 requires independent assessors to monitor controls on an ongoing basis. The strategy defines it, but no ongoing assessment has run.
findings.remarks: Schedule the SCA's first ongoing assessment with the first monitoring cycle.

findings.title: No trend analysis of monitoring results
findings.description: ca-7.3 requires trend analyses to inform control implementation and monitoring frequency. No monitoring results exist to analyze yet.
findings.remarks: Run the strategy's trend analysis after the first two monitoring cycles.

findings.title: Effectiveness and change monitoring have not started
findings.description: ca-7.4 requires risk monitoring covering effectiveness, compliance and change. Only configuration compliance is monitored.
findings.remarks: Start the effectiveness and change metrics in the first monitoring cycle.

findings.title: Consistency analysis of monitoring has not run
findings.description: ca-7.5 requires actions to confirm policies are established and controls operate consistently. None have run.
findings.remarks: Run the consistency actions in the first monitoring cycle.

findings.title: No automated monitoring dashboard
findings.description: ca-7.6 requires automated mechanisms to keep monitoring results accurate, current and available. No dashboard exists yet.
findings.remarks: Stand up the dashboard defined in the strategy before the first monitoring report.

findings.title: Configuration changes under the shared gcsmaint account are not attributable
findings.description: cm-5.1 requires enforcement and audit of change access. Change records for the workstation and router show only the shared gcsmaint account, used by five maintainers, so a change cannot be tied to a person.
findings.remarks: Per-maintainer accounts with offline CAC sign-in in release 2.4 (2027-02); until then a signed maintenance log for every gcsmaint session. M-2 2026-10-29: recurred on 2026-10-14 (etgcs-p3-ws screen-lock change).

findings.title: Change privileges sit with shared accounts
findings.description: cm-5.5 requires privileges to change components to be limited and reviewed. Five maintainers share gcsmaint on the workstation and router, and the GDT has one vendor administrator account, so privileged holders cannot be individually limited or reviewed.
findings.remarks: Named maintainer accounts in release 2.4; request named administrator accounts from the GDT vendor and keep the shared credential under ISSO control with a use log meanwhile.

findings.title: Mission planner, flight control and video applications have unverified configuration settings
findings.description: cm-6 requires configuration settings established and documented from secure configuration guidance. The planner has no STIG and its hand-recorded SRG hardening has never been assessed; the flight control and video applications were never checked against the SRG; none was covered by the 2026-09-15 scan (STG-003, STG-004, STG-005 not reviewed). Planner vendor support ends 2027-06.
findings.remarks: Have the SCA review the planner, flight control and video settings against the Application Security and Development SRG, record STG-003..005 results, and decide on the replacement planner for release 3.0.

findings.title: Full configuration management plan not approved
findings.description: cm-9 requires a configuration management plan with roles, configuration items and procedures. Only a summary is in the package; the full plan is drafted and awaiting ISSM signature.
findings.remarks: Sign the full plan and replace the ART-CMP summary before the authorization decision.

findings.title: Full station contingency plan is not written
findings.description: cp-2 requires a contingency plan with roles, responsibilities, contacts and recovery procedures. Only the plan summary exists; it states the strategy, the 4-hour restore and critical assets but no roles, contacts or step-by-step recovery.
findings.remarks: Complete ART-CP with roles, contacts and recovery procedures before fielding and have the ISSM approve it.

findings.title: No contingency training has been given
findings.description: cp-3 requires role-based contingency training. No operator, maintainer or ISSO has been trained on the swap and restore.
findings.remarks: Train operators, maintainers and the ISSO on the swap and restore before fielding, then annually.

findings.title: Contingency plan has never been tested
findings.description: cp-4 requires the plan to be tested to determine its effectiveness. No test or exercise has run (the first tabletop is scheduled for the week of 2026-11-16, after the assessment window); only a single restore by a maintainer has been done.
findings.remarks: Run the tabletop test with the brigade before fielding, record lessons in the plan, then test annually.

findings.title: Plan test not coordinated with related plans
findings.description: cp-4.1 requires the plan test to be coordinated with related plans. No test has been coordinated with the brigade continuity or enclave incident response exercises.
findings.remarks: Coordinate the scheduled first tabletop jointly with the brigade continuity and enclave incident response exercises.

findings.title: Maintainers and the GDT administrator are not uniquely identified and authenticated
findings.description: ia-2 requires unique identification and authentication of users. The 2026-09-08 review shows 5 maintainers sharing gcsmaint on each workstation and router, and the GDT has one vendor administrator account. Open STIG findings STG-001 (workstation) and STG-002 (router), CAT II, record the same gap.
findings.remarks: Deliver per-maintainer accounts with offline CAC sign-in and a per-person GDT administrator account in release 2.4; until then log the named user of every session.

findings.title: Privileged maintenance access is single-factor
findings.description: ia-2.1 requires multifactor authentication to privileged accounts. gcsmaint and the GDT administrator account accept a password only.
findings.remarks: Require CAC and PIN for maintainer access in release 2.4.

findings.title: Shared gcsmaint used without prior individual authentication
findings.description: ia-2.5 requires individual authentication before a shared account is used. Maintainers sign in to gcsmaint directly.
findings.remarks: Retire gcsmaint, or gate it behind individual CAC sign-in, in release 2.4.

findings.title: Maintenance access uses no separate authentication device
findings.description: ia-2.6 requires one factor on a separate device for the defined access. gcsmaint and GDT administrator access use only a password.
findings.remarks: Use the CAC as the separate device for maintainer access in release 2.4.

findings.title: Shared identifiers are not assigned to individuals
findings.description: ia-4 requires identifiers assigned to an individual, group, role or device under authorization. The gcsmaint and GDT vendor administrator identifiers are used by several people and assigned to none.
findings.remarks: Issue per-maintainer identifiers in release 2.4 and record their assignment on signed requests.

findings.title: GDT administrator password never changed; gcsmaint password shared
findings.description: ia-5 requires authenticator management including change and protection. The GDT administrator password has not changed since installation, and the gcsmaint password is shared by 5 people.
findings.remarks: Change the GDT administrator password now and on a 60-day cycle; replace shared passwords with per-person authenticators in release 2.4.

findings.title: Password-based authentication does not meet requirements for shared and GDT accounts
findings.description: ia-5.1 requires password composition, change and protection rules. The GDT administrator password has no change cycle and the gcsmaint password is shared.
findings.remarks: Apply the 60-day change and composition rules to the GDT account now; retire shared passwords in release 2.4.

findings.title: gcsmaint authenticator is not protected from disclosure
findings.description: ia-5.6 requires authenticators protected commensurate with the access they permit. The privileged gcsmaint password is known to all 5 maintainers.
findings.remarks: Replace the shared password with per-person authenticators in release 2.4.

findings.title: Same shared account across all workstations and routers
findings.description: ia-5.8 requires managing the risk of one account on multiple systems. gcsmaint has the same password on every workstation and router, so one disclosure exposes all stations.
findings.remarks: Per-maintainer accounts in release 2.4; meanwhile set a distinct gcsmaint password per device.

findings.title: No incident response training
findings.description: ir-2 requires role-based incident response training. No operator, maintainer or ISSO has been trained.
findings.remarks: Train operators, maintainers and the ISSO before fielding and record it.

findings.title: No breach-handling training
findings.description: ir-2.3 requires training on responding to breaches of personally identifiable information. None has been given.
findings.remarks: Add breach handling to the incident response training before fielding.

findings.title: Incident response capability never tested
findings.description: ir-3 requires testing the incident response capability. No test or tabletop has been held (the tabletop is scheduled for the week of 2026-11-16, after the assessment window).
findings.remarks: Hold a tabletop with the brigade and the CSSP before fielding and record the lessons.

findings.title: Incident response test not coordinated with related plans
findings.description: ir-3.2 requires coordinating the test with related plans. No test has been coordinated with the brigade or the CSSP.
findings.remarks: Run the first tabletop jointly with the brigade and the CSSP.

findings.title: Station incident handling procedure not written
findings.description: ir-4 requires an incident handling capability covering preparation, detection, containment, eradication and recovery. CSSP support works and isolation and reimage were walked through, but the station-level procedure exists only as the ART-IRP summary.
findings.remarks: Write the station handling procedures in the full ART-IRP before fielding.

findings.title: Planner and GDT incidents handled without automated support
findings.description: ir-4.1 requires automated support for incident handling. DT-1 confirmed mission planner and GDT logs are not forwarded to the collector.
findings.remarks: Forward planner and GDT logs to the enclave collector and set a delivery date (S-6 condition 4).

findings.title: Planner and GDT events not correlated
findings.description: ir-4.4 requires correlating incident information. Planner and GDT events never reach the CSSP.
findings.remarks: Same fix as FND-041: forward planner and GDT logs.

findings.title: Insider threat handling cannot attribute maintenance actions
findings.description: ir-4.6 requires an insider threat incident handling capability. Records show gcsmaint, not the maintainer, so maintenance actions cannot be tied to a person.
findings.remarks: Individual maintainer accounts in release 2.4; meanwhile a signed log naming the user of every gcsmaint session.

findings.title: Full incident response plan not written
findings.description: ir-8 requires an approved incident response plan with roadmap, metrics and roles. Only the ART-IRP summary exists.
findings.remarks: Complete ART-IRP before fielding and have the ISSM approve it.

findings.title: Incident response plan has no breach section
findings.description: ir-8.1 requires breach-handling content in the plan. The summary has none.
findings.remarks: Add the breach section to the full ART-IRP.

findings.title: No spillage response training
findings.description: ir-9.2 requires spillage response training. None has been given.
findings.remarks: Add spillage response to the incident response training before fielding.

findings.title: Maintenance records do not identify the maintainer
findings.description: ma-2 requires maintenance records including who performed the work. Logs show the shared gcsmaint account; the maintainer is named only for scheduled work.
findings.remarks: Name the maintainer for every logged action now; individual maintainer accounts in release 2.4.

findings.title: Privileged maintenance tool use not attributable
findings.description: ma-3.5 requires monitoring the use of maintenance tools with privileged access. Under gcsmaint the person using privileged tools is not recorded.
findings.remarks: Individual maintainer accounts in release 2.4; meanwhile a signed log of each privileged session.

findings.title: Supplier diversity of protection layers not shown
findings.description: pl-8.2 requires that the allocated controls be obtained from different suppliers. The architecture description names the layers but no layer's supplier; the integrator does not hold the enclave layers' supplier records.
findings.remarks: Record each layer's supplier in the architecture description, obtaining the enclave layers' suppliers from the enclave provider.

findings.title: Planner and GDT logging not centrally managed
findings.description: pl-9 requires centrally managing the defined controls. The SSP states logs go to the enclave collector, but DT-1 and the ISSO confirm planner and GDT logs stay on the device. Same root cause as the audit and incident-response log-forwarding findings (FND-041, FND-042) and S-6 condition 4.
findings.remarks: Forward planner and GDT logs to the enclave collector on the date set for S-6 condition 4, and correct the pl-9 SSP statement in A-5.

findings.title: Station not entered in the Component PII inventory
findings.description: pm-5.1 requires an inventory of systems that process PII. The Component inventory exists, but the station's entry is made from the approved privacy threshold analysis, which still lacks the SAOP designee's signature (open S-6 condition). Same root cause as FND-052 and FND-053.
findings.remarks: Obtain the privacy threshold analysis approval and enter the station in the Component PII inventory.

findings.title: Authority to process PII not approved
findings.description: pt-2 requires determining and documenting the authority that permits the processing of PII. The authority is written in the privacy threshold analysis, which still lacks the SAOP designee's signature; this is the open S-6 condition the SSP planned to close before S-6.
findings.remarks: Obtain the SAOP designee's approval of the privacy threshold analysis and update the pt-2 SSP statement in A-5.

findings.title: PII processing purposes not approved
findings.description: pt-3 requires identifying and documenting the purposes for processing PII. The two purposes (access, audit attribution) are written only in the unapproved privacy threshold analysis. Same root cause as FND-052.
findings.remarks: Close with FND-052: obtain the approval and update the pt-3 SSP statement in A-5.

findings.title: Known GDT and mission planner vulnerabilities remain open and the planner configuration is not scanned
findings.description: ra-5 requires vulnerabilities to be scanned and remediated within defined response times. The 2026-09-15 scan's GDT management web service vulnerability (vendor rating high) awaits firmware 5.2.1, the two medium planner library findings have no vendor fix date, and the planner has no STIG so its configuration is outside the compliance scan. The GDT service is reachable only from the station internal segment.
findings.remarks: Install firmware 5.2.1 in the 2026-12 bundle and rescan; record a risk acceptance or compensating measure for the planner library findings until the release 3.0 replacement; add an SRG-based check of the planner to the monthly scan.

findings.title: Open findings are not tracked in a POA&M
findings.description: ra-7 requires responses to findings to be tracked. Responses are recorded only in the risk assessment; no POA&M with milestones exists.
findings.remarks: Open the POA&M in A-6 with every open finding of this assessment and review it monthly. M-2 2026-10-29: closed on evidence; the A-6 POA&M tracks every open finding and is reviewed monthly.

findings.title: Privacy threshold analysis not approved
findings.description: ra-8 requires a privacy impact assessment where needed. The threshold analysis that decides whether one is needed still lacks the SAOP designee's signature; the SSP planned the decision before S-6. Same root cause as FND-051..053.
findings.remarks: Obtain the SAOP designee's decision on the threshold analysis and, if required, complete the privacy impact assessment.

findings.title: Threat hunting cannot see mission planner and GDT logs
findings.description: ra-10 requires threat hunting across the system. The CSSP hunt runs on the enclave collector, which receives no planner or GDT logs. Same root cause as FND-007/008.
findings.remarks: Forward planner and GDT logs to the enclave collector together with the FND-007/008 fix.

findings.title: No replacement selected for the mission planner before end of support
findings.description: sa-3.3 requires a plan for technology refresh. Vendor support for the mission planner ends 2027-06; the replacement is a release 3.0 decision, the market survey has not started and there is no selection date.
findings.remarks: Start the market survey and set a selection date that leaves time to field release 3.0 before 2027-06.

findings.title: No security documentation for the mission planner
findings.description: sa-5 requires administrator documentation for secure configuration. The planner vendor publishes no security guide, and the integrator's hand-hardening list has never been verified.
findings.remarks: Have the integrator turn the hand-hardening list into a verified configuration guide checked against the Application Security and Development SRG.

findings.title: Accountability not designed in for maintenance actions
findings.description: sa-8.22 requires accountability and traceability. Maintenance under the shared gcsmaint account cannot be tied to a person. Same root cause as FND-009, FND-019 and FND-027.
findings.remarks: Deliver per-maintainer accounts with offline CAC sign-in in release 2.4 (2027-02).

findings.title: Mission planner hardening untested
findings.description: sa-11 requires developer security testing. Neither developer testing nor DT-1 covered the planner's hardening, and no SRG check was run during this assessment (STG-003 not reviewed). Same gap as FND-021.
findings.remarks: Run an SRG-based test of the planner hardening before the next release and record the result in the STIG summary.

findings.title: GDT management web service can be crashed from an adjacent network
findings.description: sc-5 requires protection against denial-of-service events. The GDT management web service has a published vulnerability that lets an adjacent network crash it (2026-09-15 scan); firmware 5.2.1 is in regression testing. The service answers only on the station internal segment, which the assessor confirmed. Same root cause as FND-054.
findings.remarks: Install firmware 5.2.1 in the 2026-12 bundle and rescan; keep the internal-segment restriction until then. M-2 2026-10-29: still open on all six stations in the 2026-10-24 scan.

findings.title: Known GDT and mission planner flaws are not remediated
findings.description: si-2 requires flaws to be remediated within defined times. The 2026-09-15 scan's GDT management web service vulnerability (vendor rating high, reachable only from the station internal network) awaits firmware 5.2.1 in the 2026-12 bundle; the two medium planner library findings have no vendor fix date; the 2026-10 workstation and router fixes are installed but not confirmed by a rescan. Same root cause as FND-054.
findings.remarks: Install firmware 5.2.1 in the 2026-12 bundle and rescan all six stations; record a compensating measure or risk acceptance for the planner library findings until the release 3.0 replacement. M-2 2026-10-29: the 2026-10-24 rescan confirmed the workstation and router fixes; the GDT and planner flaws remain open.

findings.title: Mission planner and GDT are not monitored
findings.description: si-4 requires the system to be monitored for attacks and unauthorized activity. Planner and GDT logs are local only (DT-1), and station monitoring is reviewed only in test-event weeks. Same root cause as FND-007.
findings.remarks: Forward planner and GDT logs to the enclave collector; until then export and review them at each reconnect and run the weekly station review on every fielded station. M-2 2026-10-29: weekly hand review ran on the six test-range stations; forwarding still has no date.

findings.title: Radio-link intrusion attempts are not seen
findings.description: si-4.14 requires wireless intrusion detection. The GDT rejects unkeyed terminals (DT-1) but records attempts only in its local log, which nobody reviews.
findings.remarks: Include GDT rejected-command records in the log forwarding and the ISSO review.

findings.title: Planner and GDT events are not correlated
findings.description: si-4.16 requires correlation of monitoring information across the system. Planner and GDT events never reach the collector. Same root cause as FND-008.
findings.remarks: Forward planner and GDT logs to the enclave collector; set a target date in the POA&M.

findings.title: Privileged and maintainer activity is not reviewed between test events
findings.description: si-4.19 requires additional monitoring of individuals posing increased risk. The weekly report covering maintainers and administrators exists only for test-event weeks, and gcsmaint actions cannot be attributed to a person. Related to FND-007 and FND-009.
findings.remarks: Run the weekly privileged-activity review on every fielded station and replace the shared gcsmaint account with individual maintainer accounts. M-2 2026-10-29: weekly review now ran every week; attribution still fails until release 2.4 (planned 2027-02).

findings.title: Mission planner input validation not independently tested
findings.description: si-10 requires validity checks on information inputs. The planner's validation is the vendor's own and neither developer testing nor DT-1 covered it. Same gap as FND-021 and FND-061.
findings.remarks: Include input validation in the SRG-based test of the planner before the next release, or in the release 3.0 replacement's acceptance tests.

findings.title: Mission planner end of support is an unmitigated supply chain risk
findings.description: sr-3 requires processes to identify and address supply chain weaknesses. Vendor support for mission planner version 7 ends 2027-06; after that, flaws such as the open library findings will get no fix. No replacement is selected and no selection date is set. Same root cause as FND-058.
findings.remarks: Set a selection date for the release 3.0 planner replacement that leaves time to field it before 2027-06, and record the interim risk response in the POA&M.
